form.title: Premium Tax Credit (PTC)
form.notes: refundable: mixed, and the two outcomes are OPPOSITE. This form reconciles the advance payments the Marketplace already made against the credit actually allowed. If the credit allowed exceeds the advances, line 26 is a REFUNDABLE net premium tax credit and goes to Schedule 3 Part II line 9. If the advances exceed the credit allowed, line 29 is a REPAYMENT — an addition to tax — and goes to Schedule 2 Part I line 1a. The two are mutually exclusive: line 26 instructs 'If line 25 is greater than line 24, leave this line blank and continue to line 27.' NOTE ON LINE NUMBERS: the net PTC is line 26 and the repayment is line 29 on the 2025 form. Line 24 is Total PTC and line 27 is the raw excess before the repayment limitation at line 28 — neither of those is the line that routes. Line 6 is 'Reserved for future use'; it formerly carried the 400%-of-federal-poverty-line eligibility cliff, which does not apply for 2025. The line 28 repayment limitation is still in force for 2025 (Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.07: $375/$750 under 200% FPL, $975/$1,950 at 200-300%, $1,625/$3,250 at 300-400%); P.L. 119-21 removes the repayment limitation for tax years beginning after December 31, 2025. Printed revision: Form 8962 (2025), Created 3/25/25.
